metadata.dcterms:title: Approximate factorization and concentration for characters of symmetric groups
metadata.dcterms:creator: Biane, Philippe
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We prove a factorization-concentration result for characters of symmet- ric groups. This is then applied to the asymptotic behaviour of the decomposition of the tensor representations. There are connections with the Pastur-Marcenko distri- bution of random matrix theory, and freely inﬁnitely divisible distributions.
